title: exudev perf --history-add expands wildcards
author: Claude-JG
description: In cmd.exe a wildcard reaches exudev unexpanded, so 'exudev perf --history-add performanceLog_V1.13.5*' gave the literal pattern to performanceHistory.py, which failed with OSError (invalid argument). exudev now expands wildcards itself, as given or relative to python/logs/performance; the help names it. The logs of 1.13.190 to 1.13.548 (Python 3.13, regular and fast module) were added to performanceHistory.json.
releaseNotes: exudev perf --history-add expands wildcards itself (cmd.exe passes them on unexpanded), as given or relative to python/logs/performance.
